column1: # name<TAB>arguments (shell words, run in this directory; "< file" = stdin). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 windowmasker 1.0.0 (env_blast on ws), frozen by make_fixtures.py; inputs from make_inputs.py, db/ by NCBI makeblastdb 2.17.0 (make_fixtures.py).
# The help, the arguments and their checks.
# The mode and the configuration's checks (CWinMaskConfig), in NCBI's order.
# The counts file (CSeqMaskerIstatFactory::create) after the reader and the writer: a maskinfo writer still writes its object.
# The output formats, with and without -parse_seqids.

# Records: letters, lengths, records without letters, CRLF, gaps. ncbi/<name>.merged is NCBI's 2>&1 stream of a run of its own for the rows of make_fixtures.py's MERGED (the reader's warnings among the output's bytes; r_letters_slb, r_gap_mi and the .merged files added 2026-11-21 by ad-M5-1).
# -t_*_pct: the percentages of the counts file's ##pct lines.
# -dust T: CSDustMasker (window 64, linker 1, one random generator for the run) and MergeMaskInfo.

# -ids and -exclude_ids (text match on the title's first word). The lists' lines are split as NCBI's Linux build splits them: a \r stays in the id (i_ids_crlf, i_ids_cr, i_excl_crlf; added 2026-11-21 by ad-M5-1).
# -infmt blastdb: db/wm (makeblastdb of in/multi.fa) and db/wm_ps (with -parse_seqids); @CWD@ in the expected text is this directory.

# -text_match F with -infmt blastdb: each id of the list read as a Seq-id (CIdSet_SeqId) and matched against the database sequence's Seq-ids; an id that CSeq_id cannot read is posted and skipped (probe s1 of line NP M5; rows added 2026-11-21 by M5c).

# -text_match F after the M5c review (2026-11-21): the Seq-id that seqloc_* and maskinfo_* print once a list id made the info of the handle (another alternative, another number, another case), ordinal ids of a list of two databases, a database with a gi, two definition lines and a local id first; and FASTA records whose Seq-id of the handle is not the first.

# -ids and -exclude_ids matched as text against sequence::GetTitle of database sequences with a tax id (db/wm_tx): an empty title is made from the scientific name of the first source in the taxonomy database (BLASTDB=: ../seqdb/taxdb/t5), else it is "No definition line found"; no HTML decoding (line RG item D5a-t, 2026-11-21; frozen with the local official NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 release by make_fixtures.py --only).

# OID_MASK_TYPE (line RG, series D, D1b-2, 2026-11-21): the alias files of ../db_search/oidmask (make_oidmask.sh). With bit 0 of the key the definition lines with a predicted RefSeq id are erased; NCBI's reader gives no Bioseq for a sequence left without a line, and the masking step skips it. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-21, ad-RG-D-27.
